key_terms.حَمٓ: The disjointed letters Ha and Mim, appearing as the opening of Surah Ash-Shura and others.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quranic letters Ha Mim?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, the disjointed letters 'Ha Mim' are viewed as divine codes whose full esoteric meaning (ta'wil) is preserved by the Ahl al-Bayt, serving as a testament to the Quran's inimitability. This specific verse initiates Surah Ash-Shura, linking the mystery of the letters to the theme of divine revelation and the authority of the Prophet and Imams in interpreting the text.
